passing_score: Initial base form passing point by Angoff method to be approved by September 2025. Future passing points established through pre-equating.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CRNI Certified Registered Nurse Infusion exam featuring 140 questions and a duration of 150 minutes covering multiple domains of practice.
editorial.overview: The CRNI Certified Registered Nurse Infusion examination is administered by the Infusion Nurses Certification Corporation (INCC). It validates professional knowledge across principles of practice, access devices, and infusion therapies, helping registered nurses demonstrate clinical proficiency by completing a total of 140 questions during a thorough 150-minute testing window established for candidates.
editorial.who_should_take: Registered nurses working in infusion therapy who want to validate their clinical expertise. Candidates build on professional experience to demonstrate mastery of infusion nursing principles, access device management, and therapy administration.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official exam guides and reference materials published by the Infusion Nurses Certification Corporation (INCC). Focus your study plan on principles of practice, access devices, and infusion therapies. Complete practice questions to assess your pacing for the 150-minute time limit across all 140 questions.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers the core standards, legal aspects, and standard guidelines governing professional infusion nursing practice while establishing standard benchmarks for quality patient care and professional accountability in modern healthcare settings today.

Focuses on the selection, insertion, maintenance, and troubleshooting of vascular access devices used in patient care, ensuring registered nurses understand proper management protocols and safety procedures during every clinical procedure.

Addresses the administration, management, and clinical monitoring associated with various complex infusion therapies, preparing clinicians to handle medications, fluids, and patient responses safely throughout the entire course of treatment.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early for your test appointment with required identification. Manage your time carefully across the 140 questions during the 150-minute testing window to ensure successful completion.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination consists of a total of 140 questions covering multiple domains of infusion nursing, including principles of practice, access devices, and infusion therapies for clinical candidates.
The initial base form passing point uses the Angoff method to be approved by September 2025. Future passing points are established through pre-equating procedures by the organization.
You are given a total duration of 150 minutes to complete all of the questions presented on the official certification test administered by the governing board.
The certification is administered by the Infusion Nurses Certification Corporation (INCC), which provides official guides and references for candidates preparing to test during the scheduled window.
